plugins.photosPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to attach photos from your library to the avalanche observations you submit. Photos are uploaded to the National Avalanche Center along with the observation.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to take photos for the avalanche observations you submit. Photos are uploaded to the National Avalanche Center along with the observation.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use your location to fill in the coordinates and elevation of an avalanche observation, to show the avalanche zones nearest you, and to share your position with your trip contacts while a trip is active.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use your location for two things: to download the current avalanche forecast for the zones near you as you travel, so it is already on your phone when you lose service; and, if you turn on trip tracking, to share your position with the contacts on your trip plan until you check in.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use your location in the background for two things: to download the current avalanche forecast for the zones near you as you drive out of service, so you are not relying on stale data at the trailhead; and, if you turn on trip tracking, to share your position with your trip contacts until you check in.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to pick the people you want to share your trip plan with. Contacts are only used to fill in a name, phone, and email you choose.
